company.name: Vanna
company.what_it_is: A composable credit / unified margin protocol for DeFi: users deposit collateral into a per-borrower smart-contract margin account (SmartAccount) and borrow credit against it, deployable across integrated venues rather than trapped in one protocol.
company.deployment: Stellar Soroban TESTNET. Not mainnet. All EVM-chain references are roadmap, not current state.

do: State the mechanism, not an adjective
Compare jobs-to-be-done ('X vs Vanna'), never superiority
Say testnet wherever capability is described
Label any worked example as illustrative
dont: Crypto hype register (moon, wen, WAGMI, LFG, gm, ape, degen)
Implying mainnet, TVL, a token, points or an audit
voice.cta_style: One plain, specific action; no urgency
voice.cta: Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance

audiences.name: Stellar & Soroban DeFi Farmers
audiences.core_pain: Capital drag from idle deposits; high friction jumping between DEX and lending tabs
audiences.value_prop: 1-click composable leverage deployed directly into Blend BLUSDC and Aquarius pools

audiences.name: EVM Migrants & Quantitative Traders
audiences.core_pain: Mempool front-running, $40 gas spikes during volatility, 10% liquidation penalties
audiences.value_prop: Sub-second rebalancing (~320ms) at $0.00014 gas with zero mempool bidding wars

audiences.name: Institutional Liquidity Providers
audiences.core_pain: Socialized bad debt and pool contamination from volatile collateral assets
audiences.value_prop: Core LendingPool protected by isolated borrower sandboxes and 1.10x Health Factor floor

pillars: Pillar 1: Composable Credit Infrastructure on Stellar Soroban

approved: Dedicated on-chain SmartAccount sandboxes isolate borrowing risk
Up to 10x leverage deployed composably into external DeFi (Blend b-tokens, Aquarius LPs)
Sub-second liquidation defense via Mercury event streaming (~320ms)
Fixed micro-gas transactions at 0.00014 XLM (< $0.0001 USD)
Dual-sided protocol: LPs deposit XLM/USDC into LendingPools for vToken yield
Strict testnet deployment at test.stellar.vanna.finance (No live mainnet token claims)
prohibited: Claiming mainnet live or advertising fake mainnet TVL
Guaranteeing zero liquidation risk or fully hedged returns without risk parameters
Claiming custody or unrestricted autonomous fund withdrawal
Claiming uncontested first mover advantage or zero competitors without market census
Calling Morpho a partner or an integration of Vanna — Morpho is a competitor

palette_usage._basis: estimate from the approved posters; the website analyzer measures it

palette_candidates.name: gtm tokens (used by the creative director)

logo.description: the ribbon mark and the lowercase wordmark 'vanna', centred at the top; never the old cube logo, never an invented mark

visual.house_style: very dark ground with a soft violet glow low-left and a magenta glow high-right; the logo centred at the top; a heavy bold sans-serif headline, centred, sentence case, under 9 words, with ONE key word or short phrase in a pink-to-violet gradient italic; one short grey subtitle line; a clean centrepiece of flat glass UI elements (cards, chips, rows with checkmarks, pills, arrows, stat tiles or a simple diagram) that explains the idea; a footer of a few bold white words then a short grey caveat that says testnet

anchors.chain: Stellar Soroban (TESTNET — never depict or imply mainnet)
anchors.account: SmartAccount — a per-borrower contract instance with its own isolated storage, drawn as a discrete sealed unit, never a shared pool
anchors.venues: Blend (b-tokens) and Aquarius (LP shares) — the external DeFi venues Vanna deploys credit into
anchors.risk: Health factor with a 1.10x liquidation floor and a 1.25x defensive-rebalance trigger
anchors.fees: Fixed micro-gas at 0.00014 XLM, no priority-fee auction

visual.prohibited: ANY cryptocurrency glyph, symbol or coin — no Bitcoin B, no Ethereum diamond, no XLM or Stellar logo, no generic coin or token prop of any metal or colour, no vaults or safes holding coins. Vanna is credit infrastructure, not a currency, and a coin in frame advertises the wrong product. Also never: mainnet or live-trading cues, token price, ticker symbols, candlestick charts, price arrows, lambos, rockets, moons, bulls or bears, neon cyberpunk grids, hooded hackers, stock-photo handshakes, any competitor logo
visual.palette_decision: 2026-09-26: ground and glows from the founder-approved posters; main accent #703AE6 as measured on vanna.finance (#7840E0) and in the OKF palette; #A387FF kept as the light accent.

arguments.name: capital efficiency
arguments.claim: composable credit: borrowed credit stays usable across venues instead of being trapped in one protocol, so the same collateral does more work
arguments.subjects: liquidity, fragmented capital, idle collateral, margin across venues and composability

arguments.name: risk isolation
arguments.claim: per-borrower SmartAccount sandboxes versus pooled debt, a 1.10x liquidation floor, deterministic liquidation
arguments.subjects: liquidation, bad debt, contagion and insolvency

arguments_note: Both apply to stories on any chain. A pooled-lending failure on Ethereum is a strong signal precisely because it demonstrates the problem Vanna solves; rejecting it for being 'EVM-centric' or 'not directly about Soroban' is a misreading.
